query:
SELECT 
  r.id,
  r.saleId,
  COUNT(ri.id) as total_parcelas
FROM receivables r
LEFT JOIN receivableInstallments ri ON r.id = ri.receivableId
WHERE r.saleId = 8130002
GROUP BY r.id
